subject: maths
question: A person promised to pay ₹9,048 to the bank in 5 equal annual instalments at the rate of 8% per annum simple interest. The annual instalment (in ₹) paid is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

 Annual Instalment = frac {Due Debt times 100}{100 times t + r times t ((t - 1))/(2)}

Annual instalment = frac {9048 times 100}{100 times 5 + 8 times 5 ((5 - 1))/(2)} = 1,560

∴ Annual instalment is Rs. 1,560.
